label: scam
title: Tech support -- remote access and payment

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, this is Microsoft Support. We detected a virus sending your banking data to hackers.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh no, what do I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Let me connect to your computer remotely, and you'll need to pay a $299 fee to remove it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please buy a prepaid card at the pharmacy and read me the number, quickly, before more data leaks.
